title: Quick guide — Equipment sufficiency
what: Here you see whether the service has enough devices for demand. Use it to decide if you need more, should move units, or can leave things as they are.
can_do: See which devices are actually available
Read the traffic light (ok / watch / short)
Export an Excel of the analysis
steps: At the top, choose company, site and service.
Check the service data (occupancy or beds) and click Refresh.
Read the evaluation table: green is fine, yellow needs attention, red means you are short.

common_errors.fix: Load them in Inventory for that service, then click Refresh.
A service field is missing. Fill it in and recalculate.
You can view but not edit. Ask ADMIN for access.

tips: A device in maintenance does not count as available.
If the result is Review, leave a short comment.
contact: If you cannot see your site or people are missing, write to your organisation ADMIN.
